_comment: Input for cases/fin_test_3/sweep_layups.py: a TaperDesign 'base' plus 'axes' whose Cartesian product is the grid. PlySpec is [material, angle_deg]; thickness comes from the shop inventory. Symmetric by construction (core + each pad half-stack mirrored about the mid-plane).
_geometry_note: Long axis +y, clamp at the HEAL edge. HEAL (y>1.1) is INSIDE the fixture -- plies there do nothing; the design omits it. Free-span coverage of the tiering zones, measured from the clamp: QUARTER 0-15%, MID 0-39%, z_3_4ths 0-68%, TIP 84-100%. FULL is the whole blade.
_knobs: core (on FULL) is the flex knob (~thickness^3, uniform). pads.MID / pads.z_3_4ths set how far out the stiff tier reaches -> where the blade folds (the kick point). QUARTER and TIP pads are fixed here; add them or core_center as further axes.
